title: 精灵偶像地铁海报场景
author: Serio_ai
categories: 产品营销,游戏素材,动漫 / 漫画,电影感 / 电影剧照,角色,城市景观 / 街景
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a cinematic anime-realism scene inside a modern Korean subway station, showing a life-size fantasy elf idol character standing beside a giant illuminated character-design advertisement poster for SERIO.

Canvas: Vertical 3:4 composition, eye-level camera, realistic station perspective, warm fluorescent indoor lighting, glossy floor reflections, shallow depth of field on background commuters.

Main subject: One tall elegant female elf with very long flowing orange hair, bright blue eyes, long pointed ears, delicate anime face, and a calm slightly serious expression. She stands on the left side of the image, facing forward with one hand gently touching or gesturing toward the poster. She wears a luxurious ivory-white fantasy concert gown: draped satin fabric, high thigh slit, translucent shawl sleeves, orange ribbon accents, gold jewelry details, thin waist ornaments, anklets, and white strappy high-heel sandals. Her design should feel like a high-end virtual idol brought into the real world, blending anime styling with photorealistic lighting and fabric texture.

Environment: Korean subway platform corridor with tiled walls, dark ceiling panels, metal columns, and blurred pedestrians in the background. Include exactly 2 overhead wayfinding signs: one large yellow sign with a left arrow, the number “3”, and Korean text meaning “exit / way out”; one smaller dark sign below it with Korean transfer text. The background should feel candid and urban, like a phone photo or street-fashion photo taken in a busy station.

Poster layout: On the right wall, create one huge backlit white poster framed in black. It is a detailed anime character sheet and concert advertisement. At the upper left of the poster, large serif orange title text reads “SERIO CONCERT”, with smaller date text “2026.5.21” and short Korean concert/event notes beneath it. The poster should contain exactly 9 main visual sections: 1 large bust portrait of the elf, 1 full-body character render, 1 profile text block in Korean, 1 design-point area with ear and costume sketches, 1 color palette/expression area, 1 fabric-flow sketch area, 1 dynamic-pose area, 1 key-scale weapon/accessory area, and 1 makeup-detail/notes area.

Counted poster details: The color palette/expression area must show exactly 8 small head portraits of the same elf, arranged as 4 across the top row and 4 across the bottom row, each with slightly different expressions or angles. The dynamic-pose area must show exactly 2 small action poses of the elf. The makeup-detail/notes area must show exactly 2 close-up blue eye drawings. The key-scale area must show exactly 2 crystal-like accessory or weapon drawings. The design-point area must include exactly 3 sketch callouts: pointed ear jewelry, upper torso/costume detail, and leg or shoe detail.

Visual style: Premium anime illustration mixed with photorealistic subway photography, soft orange-white color palette, luminous poster glow, clean fine-line concept art on the poster, elegant serif typography, tiny Korean annotation text, subtle sparkle icons around the character-sheet elements, ultra-detailed hair strands and silk folds.

Constraints: Keep the image as a single scene, not a collage. Do not add extra main characters. Avoid logos, watermarks, or readable brand names. Make the Korean microtext look like authentic design notes while keeping the main readable text limited to the title, date, station signage, and short section labels such as PROFILE, DESIGN POINT, DYNAMIC POSE, KEY SCALE, MAKEUP DETAIL, and NOTES.\

7. Bottom-third: two young women seated on chairs, one in a dark dress and one in a light cardigan, against a plain wall.

Add accessories and gothic details such as chokers, heart motifs, belts, chains, lace, fishnets, skull-like doodles, dark nail polish, and messy strands of black hair.

The gray face censor squares should be soft-gradient blurred blocks, not sharp black rectangles.

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a dark comparison screenshot showing two fantasy trading-card designs side by side, as if from an image generation benchmark UI.

Canvas: Landscape 16:9 composition, black/dark charcoal background with thin neon-green outlines. Two tall vertical panels fill the frame, left and right, separated by a narrow gap. Each panel contains one collectible monster card preview above a small status/control area.

Layout: Use exactly 2 main panels. The left panel is labeled at the bottom in cyan pixel text “VENICE-NANO-BANANA-2”; the right panel is labeled “VENICE-GPT-IMAGE-2”. Each panel has a tiny green “OK” indicator in its top-right corner. Under each label, show a small metadata row with time, “FREE”, and “1500x2100”. At the very bottom of each panel, include a row of small UI buttons/icons: thumbs up, thumbs down, red flag, “SHARE”, “STUDIO”, “HD” with an up-arrow, a refresh icon, and “SAVE”.

Subject: Both cards depict the same Pokémon-inspired character, Crystal Golem, a massive humanoid golem made of jagged gray stone and glowing purple amethyst crystals, with violet energy cracks, crystal spikes, clenched fists, and floating crystal shards. The card type uses a purple psychic/eye symbol. Make the cards look like polished fantasy trading cards, but not an exact copy of any real copyrighted card template.

Left card details: A Stage 1 card with a silver-gray border and slightly older illustrated-card look. Header text reads “STAGE 1”, Crystal Golem, and “HP 160 HP”. Include a small circular evolution portrait at top left. The artwork shows the golem from the waist up inside an underground crystal cavern with teal mushrooms and glowing green cave lights, one fist raised toward the viewer, many purple crystal shards floating around. Use clean anime/comic line art, pale lavender highlights, and a holographic sheen. Attack area contains exactly 1 attack: “Amethyst Crush” with damage “130+”. Attack text: “Discard an Energy attached to this Golem. If you do, this attack does 70 more damage.” Bottom stats show weakness “×2”, resistance “-20”, and retreat with three star/colorless symbols. Include tiny illustrator/collector text and a short flavor line near the bottom.

Right card details: A Stage 2 card with a darker, more cinematic high-detail look and a black/purple border. Header text reads “STAGE 2”, Crystal Golem, and “HP 180”. Include a small evolution box at upper left reading “Evolves from Quartz Guardian”. The artwork fills more of the card and shows the golem lunging forward through an explosive cavern of purple crystals, with one huge open hand reaching toward the viewer, intense glowing violet eyes, black rock texture, luminous amethyst veins, and many floating crystal shards. Attack area contains exactly 1 attack: “Amethyst Crush” with damage “130”. Attack text: “This attack does 20 more damage for each Energy attached to this Pokémon.” Bottom stats show weakness “×2”, resistance “-30”, and retreat with four star/colorless symbols. Add tiny illustrator/collector text and a flavor quote: “Born from the heart of ancient caverns, it wields the power of earth and crystal in perfect harmony.”

Visual style: High-contrast digital art, glossy trading-card foil effects, purple crystal magic, dark cave backgrounds, sharp details, cyan pixel UI labels, neon green UI outlines. The left card should appear cleaner and more cartoon/anime, while the right card should appear more dramatic, dense, and rendered.

Constraints: Include exactly 2 card panels and exactly 1 trading card in each panel. Include exactly 1 attack on each card. Preserve all visible English labels named above. Do not add extra cards, characters, logos, watermarks, or real brand names.\

Layout: Use a three-column storyboard grid. The left column is narrow and contains red cut labels plus timing. The center column is wide and contains cinematic anime stills. The right column is a white notes column with camera direction and action notes. There are exactly 5 horizontal rows, separated by light gray lines.

Visible cut list: 1) Cut 1, 0.0s-2.0s: wide establishing arena shot. 2) Cut 2, 2.0s-4.0s: medium-close shot of the protagonist activating a card device. 3) Cut 3, 4.0s-6.2s: extreme close-up of a card thrust toward the viewer. 4) Cut 4, 6.2s-8.5s: whip-pan summoning scene with a dragon hologram appearing. 5) Cut 5, 8.5s-10.0s: final low-angle hero-and-dragon shot.

Subject details: The protagonist is a fiery red-haired teenage anime boy wearing a red-and-black battle jacket, fingerless gloves, and a glowing mechanical card duel device on one arm. The summoned monster is a crimson armored dragon with huge wings, jagged horns, glowing red crystal chest core, and ember-like highlights. The arena is a futuristic packed stadium at night with blue neon spotlights, a glowing duel field, massive audience stands, and a giant VS screen. The main card art shows a red demonic dragon emblem and fiery energy.

Center-panel imagery: Cut 1 shows the full stadium duel field with the red-haired protagonist on the left, an opponent in white far away on the right, giant red and blue card banners, and a large glowing “VS” display in the background. Cut 2 shows the protagonist grinning confidently, holding up a red dragon card while red energy coils around the wrist-mounted duel device; intentionally obscure or soften the exact face area as if motion-blurred/censored. Cut 3 shows a sharp close-up of one intense red eye and the raised dragon card, with rack-focus depth of field and explosive red particle streaks behind it. Cut 4 shows a red magic circle covering the arena floor as the dragon materializes in holographic flame beside the protagonist. Cut 5 shows the protagonist standing heroically beside the fully formed dragon, both lit from below by red embers and dramatic battle light.

Right-column text notes: For Cut 1 write “wide shot / dolly in / audience cheers, introduce protagonist”. For Cut 2 include the red Japanese quote 「来い、紅蓮王ドラグレイザー！」 followed by “medium-close-up / fearless smile / device activation”. For Cut 3 write “extreme close-up / rack focus / thrust card toward camera”. For Cut 4 write “whip pan / hologram summon / dragon appears”. For Cut 5 write “low angle / orbit shot / decisive cut”.

prompt_en:
Shot with a high-definition underwater camera, this prompt captures real underwater natural scenery in a clear shallow stream next to a tropical primeval forest.

Vertical composition, 3:4 aspect ratio, medium-to-long shot. The lens is slightly below the water surface, showing the shimmering bottom of the water surface above with realistic water wave refraction and natural reflections.

title: 演唱会舞台上的三位安卓偶像少女
author: 岡安モフモフ（アーガイル社長）＠ChatGPT/Gemini/ClaudeなどLLMでサービス作る人
categories: 游戏素材,漫画 / 分镜,动漫 / 漫画,赛博朋克 / 科幻,角色,群像 / 情侣
prompt_en: A full-body anime illustration of 3 humanoid AI assistant idol girls standing side by side on a glossy futuristic concert stage, shown in a straight-on front view with their full figures visible from head to shoes. They are designed as the same base android model with subtle personality differences expressed mainly through costume design, pose, and color balance rather than body type. All 3 have short silver-gray bob hair with soft waves, large over-ear mechanical headphones, pale skin, youthful idol styling, and sleek visible robotic limbs with glossy red-and-black plating and heart-shaped accent motifs. The setting is a large indoor live venue with steel truss rigging overhead, bright white and pink-purple stage spotlights, giant LED screens in the background, and reflective black stage flooring with glowing grid lines and mirror-like reflections. The overall mood is polished, cute, futuristic, and high-end, with dramatic concert lighting and crisp detailed rendering. The left girl wears a mostly black idol outfit with red accents: a cropped translucent black jacket over a short black dress or romper with a flared skirt, black armored thigh-high mechanical legs, chunky black platform boots, red gloves, and small heart details throughout; she stands with knees slightly inward and both hands pressed to her cheeks in a shy, affectionate pose, with a sweet blushing expression. The center girl wears a balanced red-and-white idol outfit: a white sleeveless top with red heart accents, a layered burgundy-red frilled mini skirt, fully exposed red-and-black robotic arms and legs, and red platform shoes; she stands in a neutral straight upright pose with one hand raised lightly near her face, presenting the clearest full-body view of the android construction. The right girl wears a mostly red idol dress with black lace-like detailing, a black waist belt, a flared skirt with white frilled underskirt, red-and-black knee armor, and red platform shoes; she stands elegantly with one arm bent near her chest and the other arm extended outward, as if introducing the audience. Keep the trio evenly spaced across the frame. Emphasize the contrast between soft idol fashion and hard mechanical anatomy, with 3 distinct costume variations in black-dominant, red-and-white balanced, and red-dominant palettes. Highly detailed anime key visual, ultra-clean linework, glossy materials, soft facial shading, sparkling highlights, cinematic stage atmosphere, and premium promotional art quality for the idol unit Hallucinations.\

categories: 海报 / 传单,插画,复古 / 怀旧,产品,动物 / 生物
prompt_en: Create a vertical poster-style AI artwork on a clean white background featuring a highly detailed Shigaraki ware tanuki ceramic statue centered full-body, photographed/illustrated like a glossy speckled pottery object with beige belly, dark brown limbs, mottled glaze, rounded belly, small navel, large straw hat, sake bottle in one paw, and a tokkuri flask or ledger-like accessory in the other. The tanuki’s face is deliberately obscured by a perfectly centered opaque square censor block in warm taupe brown, covering the upper torso and face area while leaving the hat rim visible behind it. Surround the statue with energetic abstract graphic-design elements: concentric halftone circles, black-and-white diagonal stripes, dotted gradients, thin radial sunburst lines behind the hat, hot pink and orange blocks, yellow arcs, black rings, magenta splatter, small crosses, grid textures, and subtle glitch-like cyan/magenta color offsets around the statue edges. Use a high-contrast mixed-media style combining realistic ceramic texture with modern pop-art poster graphics, crisp studio lighting, sharp details, and a balanced symmetrical composition. Add a small handwritten signature and date in the bottom right reading May 14, 2026 and Ogygia. Keep the background mostly white, no extra characters, no readable text beyond the date/signature and the bottle markings, and emphasize the unique quality of a Shigaraki ware tanuki statue.\

title: 雨天日本视觉小说标题画面
categories: 游戏素材,电影感 / 电影剧照,动漫 / 漫画,建筑 / 室内,风景 / 自然
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a moody Japanese visual-novel title screen for a dark fantasy strategy game named 紫陽花連鎖.

Canvas: 4:3 landscape game menu screen, approximately 920×768, with a dark cinematic vignette and refined antique framing.

Background: A rainy midnight Japanese garden scene. Show heavy diagonal rain streaks over a shadowy stone path and wet reflective ground. On the left, place a traditional wooden building with a warm glowing round window; on the right, a dark pagoda-like pavilion with faint warm window lights. Add silhouettes of trees, fences, shrubs, lantern-like structures, and clusters of pale purple hydrangeas in the lower left and lower right foreground. Keep the scenery atmospheric, low-contrast, and mostly obscured by darkness and mist.

Layout: Center the title area in the upper-middle of the screen. Above the title, add a thin gold horizontal divider line split by a small circular emblem containing a simple four-point sparkle/star. Use elegant metallic gold typography for the large Japanese title. Beneath it, add the small subtitle text 六つの領域を、花で突破せよ。. Below the subtitle, place exactly 3 horizontal menu buttons stacked vertically and centered.

Menu buttons: Use exactly 3 rectangular dark purple buttons with thin gold borders, subtle inner glow, and small gold diamond ornaments near both left and right edges. The visible button labels, from top to bottom, must be: 対戦を始める, 遊び方, 設定. The first button should be slightly lighter/brighter purple than the other two, as if selected.

Frame and style: Add a thin double-line gold border around the entire screen with small decorative corner breaks and short accent line segments near the corners. Use a refined Japanese gothic aesthetic, muted indigo/black/purple palette, antique gold UI accents, painterly background art, and crisp game UI typography. Avoid modern icons, extra buttons, logos, watermarks, or characters.\

Use the attached reference image as your exact reference for composition, style, pose, facial framing, monochromatic aesthetic, and cinematic atmosphere. Maintain my exact facial identity, including facial structure, jawline, hairstyle, eye shape, eyebrows, nose, lips, skin texture, and a realistic appearance with extremely high fidelity to identity. Do not stylize, embellish, or alter recognizable facial features.

Create a high-end, black-and-white, cinematic portrait collage, composed of multiple frames, showcasing the same woman in various elegant poses and expressions throughout the composition. The overall work should evoke the aesthetic of a luxury fashion editorial poster, combined with an urban drama and action aesthetic. Use five different versions of the same attached model, artistically arranged in a layered composition with varying camera angles, facial expressions, and poses.

Center shot:
A full-length portrait of the woman, as in the attached image, standing confidently in the center, with a cinematic touch.

Side portraits:
Include close-up portraits from both sides showing different facial angles:
 one looking thoughtfully away with soft, dramatic lighting,
 one with black sunglasses and an elegant, confident demeanor,
 a profile portrait with a strong emphasis on the jawline,
 a contemplative pose with the hand close to the face.

The hair should have texture, volume, a slightly tousled look, and sharp details.

Setting and background:
Create a dark, cinematic urban rooftop/nighttime city atmosphere with blurred skyscrapers, subtle moonlight, fog, smoke clouds, floating particles, dust texture, and atmospheric haze. Add soft contour lighting, smoky overlays, and dramatic shadows to the entire collage. It includes subdued urban lighting, a grayscale contrast with a melancholic touch, reflective wet-ground textures, and layered depth effects.

Color correction should be primarily monochromatic in black and white with deep blacks, silver highlights, matte shadows, and subtle warm gray tones. Maintain ultra-realistic skin textures and high dynamic range (HDR) lighting.

Lighting: Use dramatic cinematic lighting with strong contrast, soft edge lighting, volumetric fog, shadow gradients, and luxurious editorial highlights. Faces should have sharp details with a soft, diffused glow around the hair and shoulders.

Style: Collage of ultra-realistic, cinematic, monochromatic portraits; luxury fashion editorial; dark urban aesthetic; high-end poster design; realistic male model photography; melancholic atmosphere; smoky cinematic composition; dramatic shadows; hyper-detailed skin texture; realistic fabric folds; shallow depth of field; premium magazine cover quality; 8K ultra detail; Unreal Engine 5 realism; photographic look\

prompt_en: Create a vibrant anime-style full-body illustration of a fashionable young woman on a midnight stroll through a futuristic neon city, centered in the frame and floating or stepping midair with one knee bent and one boot extended downward. She has very long flowing black hair with violet and hot-pink ombré ends, glossy highlights, and wind-swept strands streaming to the right; her face is intentionally soft-blurred and featureless like a privacy blur. Dress her in a cropped white sleeveless button shirt, loose black bomber jacket slipping off the shoulders with pink lace-up details on one sleeve, black cargo jogger pants with pockets, straps, a belt, silver chain accessories, a purple thigh strap, white slouch socks, and chunky black lace-up boots. Add punk streetwear jewelry: rings, bracelets, ear piercings, and small metal accents. The background is a deep purple night skyline with scattered glowing particles like snow or city sparks, soft bokeh lights, and five prominent neon sign elements: one tall rounded pink Japanese-style sign on the left, one vertical pink sign with Japanese-style characters near the lower center, one tall pink sign behind her on the right, one cyan vertical sign reading GUNAD, and one low foreground building sign made of bright cyan and pink horizontal bars. Use saturated magenta, violet, cyan, and electric blue lighting, strong rim light on the hair and jacket, clean cel-shaded anime rendering, crisp line art, luminous gradients, cinematic depth of field, and a dynamic urban night atmosphere. Overall mood: cool, dreamy, rebellious midnight fashion.\

prompt_en: Create an ultra-realistic candid smartphone flash photo in a messy dim apartment at night, vertical 9:16 framing, low-end Android camera look with harsh direct flash, motion blur, imperfect autofocus, grain, compression artifacts, awkward tilted composition, and raw chaotic party energy. The scene shows exactly two young adults and one black-and-white cat: on the left, a young adult with silver-gray messy shoulder-length hair wearing an oversized off-white T-shirt and light gray sweatpants, recoiling and twisting away with one arm stretched forward; on the right, a young woman with long dark hair wearing a pale T-shirt and denim shorts, barefoot, leaning forward while holding the cat. The cat is suspended between them, black-and-white tuxedo markings, mouth wide open hissing or yowling, claws gripping the left person’s forearm, creating a frantic accidental moment. Add large rectangular privacy blocks obscuring both human faces, as if posted online with identities hidden. The background is cluttered and realistic: a low table with cans, cups, bottles, snacks and trash, scattered objects on the floor, slippers near the bottom, warm dark interior lighting, doorway and furniture fading into shadow. Make it look like a badly timed real phone snapshot rather than a polished photo, with blown flash highlights, smeared movement, off-center cropping, and a sense that the photographer reacted too late.\

title: 懒惰水豚广告工作流程漫画
author: 今日もやらないAI副業
categories: 信息图 / 教育视觉,漫画 / 分镜,插画,漫画 / 图像小说,角色,动物 / 生物,文字 / 排版
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a single-page Japanese manga-style instructional comic about using a 3×3 image grid with GPT and seedance to generate advertising videos, narrated by a lazy but wise capybara. Make it look like a polished social media explainer comic with warm lighting, detailed animal rendering, and hand-drawn panel borders.

Canvas: Vertical 4:5 page, about 768×960 px, cream paper background with thin black outer border. Use a warm sepia-brown palette, soft shadows, cinematic illustration, semi-realistic capybara fur, manga speech bubbles, and clean readable Japanese typography.

Main character: A large chubby capybara with tan-brown fur, sleepy half-closed eyes, relaxed smug expression, and small dark paws. The capybara acts like a laid-back advertising strategist. Optional name: lazy capybara strategist.

Layout: Use exactly 6 comic areas: 1 large hero panel at the top, 4 smaller instructional panels in a 2×2 grid underneath, and 1 wide closing panel at the bottom.

Hero panel: The capybara sits at a wooden desk in a dim cozy office, one paw under its chin, in front of an open silver laptop. On the desk include exactly 4 visible desk items: a white mug labeled 「やる気ゼロ。」, a black smartphone, a spiral notebook labeled 「今日もやらない」 with a tiny capybara doodle, and a brown leather satchel at the right. Add a dramatic white spiky manga burst on the left with bold text: これ、地味にすごいやつやん…！. On the right side of the hero panel place a pinned beige reference poster titled 「引用元ポスト(要約)」 and main headline 「GPT5.5 × seedance 架空広告の作り方」. The poster contains exactly 9 thumbnail images in a 3×3 grid: red sports car, sneaker, perfume bottle, burger, luxury wristwatch, resort pool, coffee cup, smartphone on desk, tropical suitcase/beach scene. Under the grid, show four short numbered Japanese steps explaining: create images in a 3×3 grid, feed them to GPT to convert into a prompt, combine images plus prompt to generate video, and create variations with #higgsfield and MCP.

Instruction panel 1: Top-left small panel with blue circle number 「1」 and title 「何が便利か」. Show capybara from the chest up, thoughtful and unimpressed. Include one speech bubble saying 「3×3をまとめてGPTに食わせるから、一貫性のあるプロンプトがサクッとできる。」 Add a small visual diagram at the bottom: a tiny 3×3 color grid arrow to a document icon labeled 「プロンプト(設計図)」. Add small caption 「1枚ずつ考えるより手戻り減るで。」

Instruction panel 2: Top-right small panel with blue circle number 「2」 and title 「初心者が真似するなら」. Capybara raises one finger like giving advice. Include a speech bubble: 「まずは3×3で好きなジャンルの画像を集めてみる。無料素材や自作でOK。」 On the right show exactly 3 vertically stacked icons with arrows: a 3×3 grid labeled 「集める」, a brain labeled 「プロンプト化(GPT)」, and a play button labeled 「動画生成(seedance)」.

Instruction panel 3: Bottom-left small panel with blue circle number 「3」 and title 「注意点」. Capybara holds up two fingers with a serious sleepy expression. Speech bubble: 「権利・商用利用はちゃんと確認やで。素材の利用規約と、生成物の使いみちは自己責任。」 Along the bottom include exactly 3 warning icons with labels: yellow warning triangle 「権利確認」, document 「規約チェック」, lock 「自己責任」.

Instruction panel 4: Bottom-right small panel with blue circle number 「4」 and title 「小さく試す方法」. Capybara leans on the panel edge, explaining calmly. Speech bubble: 「いきなり全額を狙わなくてええ。3×3→1本だけ出してみる。それを見て微調整。小さく回して学ぶのがいちばん早い。」 On the right draw a circular workflow with exactly 4 steps and arrows: 「作る(3×3)」, 「出す(1本)」, 「見る(反応)」, 「調整(改善)」.

Closing panel: Wide bottom panel. Capybara lies sprawled on the desk, eyes closed, extremely lazy, with tiny snore text 「ふぅ…」. Large text on the left: 今日もやらないけど、ここだけ試すならアリ。. Add a small thought bubble: 「動いたもん勝ち…ワイは昼寝や。」 On the right place a taped yellow sticky-note checklist titled 「まとめ」 with exactly 4 unchecked items: 「3×3で設計図を作る」, 「自動で量産できる」, 「小さく回して学ぶ」, 「今日もやらない(大事)」, plus a paw-print mark.

Visual style: Detailed semi-realistic capybara, manga/comic instructional layout, warm office lighting, soft beige shadows, expressive Japanese lettering, blue numbered badges, hand-drawn ink outlines, slight paper texture, humorous but professional social media explainer aesthetic.

Constraints: Keep all Japanese text legible and in the locations described. Use exactly 6 panels, exactly 9 poster thumbnails, exactly 4 desk items, exactly 3 icons in panel 2, exactly 3 warning icons in panel 3, and exactly 4 workflow steps in panel 4. No photorealistic humans, no extra panels, no watermark, no English replacement for the visible Japanese labels.\

prompt_en: Create a realistic social-media collage of a young Japanese rookie nurse model in a hospital setting, with a natural candid atmosphere rather than a cosplay look. Use a vertical 3:4 canvas arranged as a clean 4-column by 3-row grid, exactly 12 separate photo panels with thin white gutters between them. Outfit: a fitted short-sleeve white nurse dress with rounded collar, white nurse cap, name badge, pens in chest pocket, white stockings, and white nurse shoes. Lighting should be soft fluorescent hospital light with realistic phone-camera quality, slight wide-angle selfies, natural skin texture, and shallow depth where appropriate. Composition should feel like a collection of candid behind-the-scenes hospital photos: varied angles, subtle poses, gentle expressions, clean clinical background, no text overlays, no watermark. title: 上海石库门窗外肖像
author: ToroJushiAi
categories: 社交媒体帖子,摄影,网红 / 模特,城市景观 / 街景
prompt_en:
A candid photograph of a young woman leaning on the open sill of a tiger dormer window on the upper floor of a Shanghai shikumen building, authentic daily life photography, natural candid moment. Upper-body framing shot from below at moderate distance — she rests her forearms on the window ledge, looking out over the rooftops in the late afternoon.
East Asian young woman in her early 20s. Almond-shaped eyes with natural double eyelids, slightly elongated eye corners — gaze directed outward and slightly downward toward the lane below, soft and unhurried, the expression of someone with nowhere pressing to be. Straight refined nose with a delicate bridge. Skin tone fair to light beige (NC10–NC20) — skin subsurface scattering visible under warm golden side light, specular micro-highlights on cheekbones and nose ridge and the top of one bare shoulder, fine foundation powder grain perceptible. Clean no-makeup summer skin, peachy gloss, curl in the lash.
She wears a sage green cropped ribbed knit cami with thin adjustable straps, and a denim micro mini skirt. Fine layered gold chains at her collarbone — two of them, slightly different lengths. Hair loosely half-clipped with a claw clip, several strands falling free around her jaw. She rests her chin lightly on one hand, the other arm stretched along the window ledge — the universal posture of someone watching a street from above, neither bored nor alert, simply present in summer time. The tiger dormer window frame: old dark-painted wood, slightly weathered, panes of old glass with the faint optical distortion of age. The shikumen rooflines and chimney tops spread below. Over those old tiles, in the far blurred golden distance, the recognizable silhouettes of Shanghai Tower and the SWFC tower rise as warm amber forms in the haze — modern and historic occupying one frame without apology. Two or three stray hairs displaced by the rooftop afternoon breeze, natural unplanned imperfection, not geometrically symmetrical.
Warm low-angle golden hour sunlight from the side, amber light catching her cheekbones, the top of a bare shoulder, and the gold chain — long shadows from the window frame across her forearm. Gentle and warm, quiet contentment — the Shanghai girl's private pleasure of a summer evening seen from above the lane. Subtle ISO 400 film grain in shadow areas, photographic noise texture not CG render smoothness. Aspect ratio 2:3. No watermark, no text overlay, not cartoon, not digitally painted, not illustration, not anime.\
